Name: Daily Farm Photo
Author: seawolf87
Description:
[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip into ﻿[code]Stardew Valley\Mods[/code][/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI[/size]
[/list][size=5]
Where are my screenshots?[/size]
[size=3]All screenshots are put into %AppData%\Roaming\StardewValley\Screenshots\<Farm Name>

Additionally, all screenshots taken in game through command or menu button are sorted into these <Farm Name> folders. If the file already exists (like when you repeat a day) the newer file will remain in the Screenshots main folder. Simply drag it into the <Farm Name> folder and replace existing (I will update the mod later to handle this automatically). 

[/size][size=5]Configuration
[/size][size=3]After unzipping the mod into the [code]Stardew Valley\Mods[/code] folder, run SMAPI once to generate a config.json file. After this file has been created, you can edit the values inside of it. Resolution is a 1-100 integer that represents the percentage resolution of the resulting image. 100 is a full sized image ~5-6mb whereas a setting of 25 would produce an image of ~600kb. The TakeScreenshotAfter value represents a time of day from 600-2600 after which the picture of the farm will be taken. Set this if you want all night shots of your farm.

[b]Your player (or the host in multiplayer) have to be present on your farm at/after the TakeScreenshotAfter time for the screenshot to be taken. It is highly recommended you keep this setting at 600 so you don't accidentally pass out somewhere never having taken a screenshot.[/b]
[/size]
